run_annotation_tool_C: run the annotation_tool_C script to generate an MTurk HTML question form for Minecraft command annotation
generate_mturk_html_question: generate an MTurk HTMLQuestion XML document with Bootstrap-styled annotation questions for reference object properties
render_reference_object_questions: render annotation questions for reference objects across actions like copy, destroy, spawn, fill, and get
build_css_word_hiding_script: build a CSS script that hides word placeholder classes up to MAX_WORDS when corresponding URL params are missing
build_js_question_display_script: build a JavaScript script that shows the correct question div based on intent and child name from URL params
